faqs.question: The colors on my printouts do not match the colors on my computer monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following recommended color correction methods:
Use ICC profiles during the color management process.
Ensure that you are using the correct output profile for your loaded media.
Note:
You may need to create a custom ICC profile for the best results.
Ensure that your monitor is calibrated and is displaying accurate color.
Compare the print result with the image on your computer screen in a well-lit environment. Since monitors and printers produce colors differently, printed colors and screen colors do not always look the same.
If the recommendations above do not help, contact Epson support.
The color management process is complex. We can assist you with the proper assignment of settings; however, we cannot assist you with creating a custom color profile.

faqs.question: I see horizontal or vertical lines in my printout. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Perform a nozzle check from the printer's control panel or the Epson printer driver, then do one of the following:
If there are gaps in the nozzle check pattern, clean the print head nozzles.
If there are no gaps in the nozzle check pattern, try the solutions below.
Horizontal Banding
Increase the print resolution.
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Select an alternate paper profile for ink coverage.
Select the correct paper type in the printer driver.
Adjust the paper feed
Vertical Banding
Turn off
Simple Settings
and uncheck the
High Speed
setting in the printer driver.
Align the print head.

faqs.question: I see the message Communication Error when I use a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Delete all print jobs in the print queue.
Turn the printer off.
Note:
Make sure the USB cable is connected correctly.
Restart your computer. When the desktop appears, turn your printer on and follow the on-screen instructions.
Note:
If the problem continues, turn the printer off again and delete the printer in the list of printers. Then disconnect the USB cable from the printer and connect it again.

faqs.question: My product displays an error after I connect a USB memory device to it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure the USB memory device meets the printer's specifications, that it is properly formatted, and that it is not corrupt.
To clear the error, turn off the printer, remove the USB memory device from the printer, then turn the printer back on.
USB Memory Device Requirements
Make sure your USB memory device meets these requirements.
Note:
Connections that use an extension cable, a USB hub, or a card reader cannot be guaranteed.
FAT device compatible with Windows
Format type: FAT 32
No security functions such as encryption or passwords
Memory capacity: Up to 128GB
Partitions: 1
Requirements for data
Data name: Up to 255 single-byte characters
Data size: Up to 4GB
Number of data items: Up to 256 (.prn files only)
Note:
Save the data in the root folder on the USB memory device and use only the .prn file extension. If the data is saved in a sub-folder or named incorrectly, it is not displayed even if the USB memory device is connected to the printer.

faqs.question: What size ink cartridges does my product use?
faqs.answer: The printer uses 250ml ink cartridges with optional 600ml cartridges for each ink color.

faqs.question: Can I use my product's ink cartridges with products?
faqs.answer: No, the ink cartridges are designed specifically for the SureColor F2000 printer and will not work with other Epson products.

faqs.question: How many ink cartridges are in my product?
faqs.answer: The White Edition uses 6 cartridges, white (2), cyan, magenta, yellow, and black. The Color Edition uses 6 cartridges, cyan (2), magenta (2), yellow, and black.

faqs.question: Can I buy media for my product from Epson?
faqs.answer: Epson does not sell T-Shirts, other garments or textile material. However, products suitable for DTG (Direct-to-Garment) printing can be purchased from third-party vendors.

faqs.question: Which media does my product support?
faqs.answer: The printer supports cotton and cotton blend garment cloth.

faqs.answer:
For the best experience, we recommend an authorized Epson DTG (Direct-to-Garment) reseller set up the printer; this can be done on-site or by remote assistance. This service is available for purchase.

faqs.answer:

faqs.answer:
Hi-Speed USB (compatible with the USB 2.0 specification) and 10BASE-T/100Base-TX.
Note:

faqs.question: Is a heat press included with my product?
faqs.answer: No, a heat press is not included. A heat press can be purchased separately from an authorized DTG (Direct-to-Garment) reseller. You can also use a heat tunnel to cure T-shirts.

faqs.question: How long is my product warranty?
faqs.answer:
The printer comes with a one-year warranty covered under the Epson Preferred Protection Plan. Additional one-year service plans can be purchased to cover the product through a total of three years.
Note:
You may purchase an extended service plan anytime during the one-year limited warranty period. You may purchase one additional plan to follow your first plan (for a total of two extended service plans), if each purchase is made during the warranty period or while a service plan is still in effect. No renewal of extended service is available after expiration of your second plan.

faqs.question: Will my product print on fabric?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the printer is a DTG (Direct-to-Garment) printer and will print directly on cotton fabric or blends.
Note:
If you print on dark fabric, you need to use white ink as a basecoat. When you use white ink, you need to pre-treated the T-shirt and make sure it's completely dry before you print.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for support?
faqs.answer:
For the heat press, contact the manufacturer of the heat press. Epson does not offer support or warranty on the heat press.
For the software and the printer, contact Epson. If the printer requires service, contact Epson to schedule a service call.
